Product page:
AC Powered BLE Wall Mount Gateway (Amaya Pro) (06995)

The Amaya Pro 06995 is a wall-mounted gateway designed for connected smart-lighting systems. It combines Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and Ethernet communication and supports up to 500 connected devices.
The gateway is powered by a DC 12V, 2A adapter and provides a maximum communication distance of 200 feet. It includes 8GB of eMMC storage, 2GB of LPDDR3 memory, and Bluetooth scanning capacity of up to 200 BLE packets per second.
Wi-Fi connectivity supports remote power monitoring and wireless control. The gateway supports IEEE 802.11b/g/n wireless operation, 2.4GHz and 5GHz frequency bands, router and repeater modes, WPA/WPA2-PSK security, and optional 4G mobile-network connectivity.
The 06995 supports single-channel dimming and scene control, HTTP and MQTT communication using SSL/TLS, and over-the-air firmware upgrades. Its BLE module includes a built-in power amplifier, while the flexible FPC antenna supports wireless communication within the connected Amaya Pro system.

Battery Powered BLE Wall Switch (Amaya Pro) (06950)

The Amaya Pro 06950 is a battery-powered Bluetooth Mesh wall switch designed for lighting and room-control applications. It includes eight dedicated keys for ON/OFF, automatic mode, brightness adjustment, correlated color-temperature adjustment, and scene selection.
The switch is powered by two CR2032 coin-cell batteries connected in parallel at a nominal 3V. Its ultra-low sleep current and 5–7mA working current provide a listed battery life of approximately 7–10 years.
Bluetooth 5.1 Mesh communication operates in the 2.4GHz ISM band and provides a maximum wireless-link distance of 100 feet. Messages can be relayed through compatible powered Bluetooth Mesh nodes to extend coverage beyond one direct wireless link.
The 06950 supports up to 20 programmable scenes for lighting presets and room functions. LED feedback confirms button presses and provides a low-battery warning, while a long press on any key places the switch into Amaya app registration mode.

DC Powered Wireless BLE Wall Switch (LiteLinQ) (06507)

The LiteLinQ 06507 is a wireless smart switch and wall-mount remote-control kit designed for indoor lighting management. It provides convenient wall-mounted operation together with flexible remote-control functionality.
The switch operates at 3V and communicates through Bluetooth Mesh. It has a maximum communication distance of 65 feet and operates across a communication-frequency range of 2405–2480MHz.
Lighting can be controlled using either the LiteLinQ app or the wall switch. The switch includes ON/OFF, brightness increase, brightness decrease, automatic control, and three scene-selection functions.
The 06507 includes a built-in node identified as an integrated gateway. The specification also provides dedicated procedures for pairing the switch with the app and resetting it to its default settings.

- The indicator light flashes for 20 seconds while pairing is active.
- After pairing, press ON/OFF and Brightness+ again to activate the remote and make it appear in the app.
- Without activation, the remote enters low-power hibernation and will not appear in the app.

Product page:
AC Powered BLE Wired Gateway (LiteLinQ) (06272)

The LiteLinQ 06272 Series provides Bluetooth Mesh self-networking with Wi-Fi connectivity for remote monitoring and wireless control of compatible Bluetooth lighting. The series includes wall-adapter, gateway, and signal-extender configurations for different installation and communication requirements.
Models 06272 01 and 06272 02 provide maximum outdoor communication distances of 164 feet. Model 06272 04 functions as a long-range signal extender and gateway box, providing a maximum outdoor communication distance of 492 feet through a 2.4G network.
The series supports remote power monitoring, wireless lamp control, single-channel dimming, and scene control. Each model includes an integrated gateway or built-in node, while the available reset method differs by configuration: hard-button reset for 06272 01, infrared remote reset for 06272 02, and Wi-Fi button reset for 06272 04.
The 06272 Series operates through the LiteLinQ app and supports Bluetooth and Wi-Fi communication. Models 06272 01 and 06272 04 operate from 100–347V, while model 06272 02 operates at 120V. The IP20 models are intended for indoor use, while the 06272 04 gateway box carries an IP65 rating.

Self Powered BLE Wall Switch (Silvair) (06306)

The Silvair 06306 is a self-powered wireless wall switch designed for control of lights and other compatible devices. Pressing the switch creates the energy required to transmit a wireless control signal.
The switch requires no wires or batteries. Its self-powered operation removes the need for battery replacement while supporting more than 200,000 button pushes.
It provides wireless communication between neighboring devices at distances up to 100 feet. The switch supports 2.4GHz global operation and functions as a dimming wall remote within the wireless network.
The 06306 is designed to work with compatible BLE drivers, controllers, signal converters, sensors, and related products. The product diagram shows a two-section switch installed in a wall box with a separate faceplate.

Product page:
AC Powered Gateway (Silvair) (06298)

The Silvair Gateway connects networks commissioned with Silvair Commissioning tools to the Silvair cloud. This connection enables scheduled lighting events and supports cloud-based services using information generated by the connected lighting network.
Gateway scheduling is available by default and can schedule changes to scenes and lighting-control scenarios, including occupancy sensing and daylight harvesting. Additional paid services can provide energy and occupancy monitoring, remote device monitoring and control, and emergency-lighting test-result monitoring.
A single gateway can handle approximately 200 devices and process approximately 450 network messages per second. It supports Ethernet and Wi-Fi connectivity, while selected Cascade-500-W and Cascade-500-X versions also support 4G LTE Cat 1 with 2G/3G connectivity.
The gateway uses secure boot, an encrypted operating system, and TLS communication with the Silvair cloud. It also supports automatic security updates, firmware updates, schedule caching, system diagnostics, and performance metrics through the Silvair web app.

- Hospitality Industry

Best for the hospitality industry, Willow G+ Downlight LED plays a crucial role in creating a pleasant ambiance, which is why it is frequently used in cafes, hotel rooms, restaurant lobbies, and more. These downlights can shift from bright lights during the daytime to soft, warm lighting in the evening to provide both functional and aesthetic lighting. - Museums And Galleries

Museums and Galleries require specialized lighting that highlights artifacts and artwork without causing damage. - Industrial And Warehouse Spaces

These warehouse lighting fixtures are specifically designed to cover expansive areas, withstand harsh conditions, and endure the demands of industrial environments.

- Research Laboratories

Downlight LEDs are preferred in research laboratories as their glare-free lighting reduces eye strain, helping scientists focus on intricate details for a long period of time. In addition, their low heat generation quality also protects valuable lab equipment.

- Transportation Hubs

Transportation hubs like airports, bus terminals, and train stations rely significantly on Willow G+ LED Downlights for visibility. Electrical Wiring:
Connect the wiring from the power source to the fixture following local electrical codes and regulations. Ensure a proper and secure connection of the wires, and use wire nuts to cover and protect the connections.

Fixture Attachment:
Securely attach the LED Covered Strip Fixture to the mounting location using the provided hardware.

Testing:
Once the fixture is installed, restore power to the installation area. Test the fixture to ensure proper functionality, brightness, and uniform illumination.

LED MAGNETIC STRIP RETROFIT

As a replacement for those energy-consuming fluorescent lights for your existing old fittings, Maverick LED presents you with a collection of retrofit kits, including LED Magnetic Strip. With its magnetic backing, you can install these in no time—just stick them to your existing fixtures, and you’re good to go! Plus, they come with customizable control settings through which you can switch to various lengths and color temperatures. If you love having control over your lights, they’re compatible with dimmer switches too.

Upgrade now to these IRIS SSR retrofit strip lights with Maverick LED!

Benefits of Using LED Magnetic Strip Retrofit Kits

Upgrade from Fluorescent Lighting

The LED Magnetic Retrofit kit serves as a direct replacement for outdated fluorescent tubes. In just a few minutes, you can replace your existing troffers, strips, or wraps with energy-efficient, long-lasting LED fixtures.

Eliminate Common Concerns

Switching from fluorescent to LED eliminates several recurring issues:

- Ongoing Replacement Costs: Reduce expenses related to replacement parts, labor, and disposal.
- Safety Hazards: Remove safety concerns associated with mercury-containing fluorescent tubes.
- Inconsistent Lighting: No more flickering or burnt-out bulbs that lead to uneven light output.

Quick and Easy Installation

Our LED Magnetic Retrofit kit simplifies the upgrade process. It easily fits into your existing fixtures, allowing for hands-free wiring. Here’s how effortless the installation is:

- Remove the old bulbs and ballast.
- Attach the Magnetic Retrofit using its magnets.
- Connect power with the quick wiring connector.
- Close the fixture and restore power.

Consistent & Adjustable Lighting Source

Our LED Magnetic Retrofit delivers improved efficiency and quality light, resulting in a better experience for anyone using the space. With it, you can have a uniform light output from fixture to fixture, room to room. It also allows you to set optimal light levels based on occupant preferences or time of day.

Choose the best LED Magnetic Strip Retrofit Kits

1. Adjustable Wattage

Opt for a retrofit kit that allows you to fine-tune the light output to match your needs. Kits with adjustable wattage help optimize energy consumption by letting you set each fixture to a specific output level. This assures that you cap energy use effectively while achieving the desired brightness.

2. High Output

For those seeking an economical yet efficient option, high-output retrofit kits are a great choice. They provide lumen levels comparable to traditional three-tube fluorescent models while maintaining affordability. Like the adjustable wattage options, these fixtures also include tri-level dimming, allowing for seamless brightness adjustments without extra installations.

3. Ease of Installation

Buy a retrofit kit with simple, plug-and-play solutions, the one that often comes with pre-wired fixtures and easy mounting options. This can significantly reduce installation time and costs, allowing for a hassle-free upgrade.

4. Color Temperature Options

Different applications may require specific color temperatures for optimal performance. LED retrofit kits typically come in a range of color temperatures, measured in Kelvin (K). Consider the type of ambiance you want to create; warmer tones (2700K-3000K) are ideal for residential settings, while cooler tones (4000K-5000K) are often better for commercial spaces. Look for kits that allow you to choose or switch between color temperatures for added flexibility.

5. Lifespan and Warranty

Choose kits that offer a long operational life, typically around 70,000 hours. Additionally, check the warranty period; a longer warranty indicates the manufacturer's confidence in their product's durability and performance. Consider the one with a 5-7-year warranty.
Upgrade your lighting with Maverick LED's LED Magnetic Strip Retrofit Kits. Perfect indoor and outdoor LED lighting, compatible with pole mounts for energy-efficient, secure installations. Brighten your space today!

docs.title: Exit/Emergency - Chicago Approved
docs.text:
Ensure the safety and compliance of your building with Chicago Approved Exit Signs from Maverick LED. Our range includes the exit sign combo, retrofit kit, and emergency bug eye each designed to ensure compliance with local regulations and standards.

Whether upgrading your current signage or installing new systems, our exit signs offer easy installation with existing wires. They feature long-lasting, energy-efficient LED illumination, Ni-Cd batteries for emergencies, and a maintenance-free rechargeable battery to prevent deep battery discharge. With warranties providing peace of mind, our products are built to deliver reliable, code-compliant performance. Plus, we offer free photometrics to ensure optimal placement and performance. Take a look at our extensive selection now!

Exit/Emergency - Chicago Approved Signs Range

Exit Sign Retrofit Kit

Upgrade your current signage with the Maverick LED Exit Sign Retrofit Kit, designed to meet Chicago's strict safety standards. Our retrofit kit is simple to install and smoothly integrates with most Box and Edgelit Signs while eliminating the need for grounding. The kit includes a 3.5W COB LED light source, providing 400 lumens of bright white illumination. It is made from UL-listed thermoconductive plastic and features compact dimensions of 9-1/2" x 1-1/16" x 3/4" with 2' leads. This maintenance-free solution comes with a 10-year Limited Warranty and is eligible for rebates.

Emergency Bug Eye 2 Heads

For dependable emergency lighting, Our Emergency Bug Eye 2 Heads is the ideal choice. Backed by a five-year warranty, it features dual 6V/12V 12W halogen lamp heads and supports dual 120V/277V voltage. With a rechargeable 6V battery, emergency bug eye 2 heads have a low-voltage disconnect to prevent deep discharge. Plus, the system provides 120 minutes of emergency illumination and is housed in durable 20-gauge steel, available in white or black.

Exit Sign Kit

This City of Chicago-approved kit features ultra-bright white LEDs, offering long-lasting and energy-efficient illumination. It operates on dual 120V/277V power sources, is built with durable 20-gauge steel housing, and includes a rechargeable Ni-Cd battery for emergency lighting. Both electronics and housing are covered by a 5-year warranty. The kit adheres to UL924, NFPA101, NEC, OSHA, and local and state codes, ensuring comprehensive compliance and reliability.

Exit Sign Combo

Our Exit Sign Combo is a versatile solution for both exit and emergency lighting needs, fully approved for use in Chicago. It offers durable 20-gauge steel construction similar to the Emergency Bug Eye 2 Heads and provides white LED illumination. Operating on dual voltage (120V/277V), these exit sign combo delivers 120 minutes of emergency lighting. The fixture is equipped with a maintenance-free rechargeable battery featuring a low-voltage disconnect, imaging the reliability of the Exit Sign Retrofit Kit.

In addition to our Chicago Exit/Emergency signs, we offer a great selection of outdoor retrofit kits and LED emergency drivers to upgrade your existing fixtures and ensure reliable emergency lighting.

Chicago Approved Exit Signs Standards

In Chicago, exit signs must meet these specific requirements -

-
They should be rectangular 20 gauge sheet metal boxes with a glass or plastic face.

-
The lettering on the sign should be stenciled with red on a white background, and the letters and arrows on the exit signs must be red.

-
The directional arrows should be positioned below the sign lettering and be the same width as the lettering.

-
Additionally, all exit signs need to be internally illuminated, requiring at least a 10-watt electric lamp.

Improve accessibility and meet legal requirements with Maverick LED’s Chicago Approved Exit Signs. Contact us for a quote today!

At Maverick LED, we offer an amazing range of LED flat panel lights that are perfect for offices, warehouses, homes, and so many other places. Unlike traditional fluorescent lights, our LED panels last longer and consume less energy, saving you money in the long run. Their slim, sleek design makes them ideal for any space, whether mounted on a flat surface or integrated into a drop ceiling. These lights even offer eye-friendly illumination that improves productivity in your workspace. Not just that, they also save you money on energy bills and prompt maintenance costs. Whether you need to retrofit existing fixtures or start a new project, Maverick LED has the perfect solution to meet your lighting needs.

Light up your space with lower energy bills with our highly efficient LED Flat Panel Lighting. Here is a sneak -peak at the collection of flat panel LED lights on our website:

Our Product Range in Flat Panel LED Lights

Each light features advanced LED technology for excellent brightness, superior energy efficiency, and high-quality illumination. Their extruded aluminum body provides exceptional heat dissipation for long-lasting efficiency and durability. Each of the flat panel LED lights on is equipped with a Maverick LED driver that allows support for customizable lighting intensity with 0-10V dimming for enhanced control. You are also getting control for customizable light intensity with sensors and mobile control features. These flat panel LED lights even come with a 7-year warranty covering all components, including the LED driver, providing peace of mind and an assured guarantee.

However, to buy your preferred one, here are the details of each that differentiates it from another.

BACK-LIT PANEL RETROFIT (LOTUS GSR):

LED BACK-LIT PANEL LIGHT (SMART SWS):

It is known for its integration with smart technology. This panel offers advanced controls and customization options. It supports adjustable wattage and is sensor-ready, making it suitable for modern smart home environments.

LED FLAT BACK-LIT THIN PANEL LIGHT (SPRUCE GSR+):

If you like ultra-thin design panels, this one is for you. This panel is perfect for installations where space is limited.

LED Flat Panel Light Applications

Office Lighting: LED flat panel lights are great for offices because they provide even, glare-free illumination. This helps reduce eye strain and makes working for long hours more comfortable, boosting overall productivity.

Commercial Spaces: In retail stores, showrooms, and restaurants, LED panels create a bright and welcoming atmosphere. They’re perfect for highlighting products and making interiors look their best.

Healthcare Facilities: LED flat panels are essential for hospitals and clinics. They deliver bright, shadow-free light, which is important for detailed medical tasks and ensures a comfortable environment for patients.

Educational Institutions: Schools and universities benefit from LED panels, too. They provide uniform lighting in classrooms and lecture halls, making it easier for students to concentrate and learn.

Residential Use: At home, LED flat panels can be used in kitchens, living rooms, and hallways. They offer sleek, modern lighting that not only looks great but also improves the functionality of your space.

Government Buildings: Municipal buildings use these efficient lights for long-lasting illumination and for lower maintenance costs, which is always a bonus.

Industrial Settings: Factories and warehouses need bright, even lighting for safety and efficiency. LED flat panels are up to the task. They create a well-lit environment that supports safe operations.

Public Spaces: For busy places like airports, train stations, and malls, LED panels provide consistent, bright lighting. This helps enhance visibility and safety in high-traffic areas, making them more comfortable for everyone.

docs.title: LED Parking Garage Lighting
docs.text:
Upgrade your parking garage with Maverick LED's superior lighting solutions, designed to enhance visibility, safety, and energy efficiency. Our lighting fixtures have a lifespan of over 70,000 hours and come with a 7 to 10-year warranty. All models have versatile optics with CCT options of 3500K, 4000K, and 5000K and strong electrical systems compatible with 120-277V or 200-480V inputs for adaptability.

Featuring advanced heat dissipation with an extruded aluminum body, our lights are built to handle demanding environments while maintaining modern aesthetics. With 0-10V dimming capabilities, motion and dimming sensors, photocells, and wireless controls, you can achieve optimal illumination with long-term reliability and performance. Explore our selection of LED garage door lights to find the perfect lighting solution for your garage:

Types of LED Outdoor Garage Lighting Fixtures

LED Garage Canopy Light (Kodiak G)

Constructed with a die-cast aluminum body and prismatic polycarbonate lens, the Kodiak G can be used for LED parking lot lighting fixtures. Mounting options include soffit, canopy, and surface installations, allowing for versatile placement to suit the environment best. With adjustable settings, you can customize brightness and direction for specific needs.

LED Vapor Tight Fixture (Hazel GSR)

This tight fixture combines LED efficiency with advanced optics, providing high-lumen output and a vapor-tight construction. It is surface-mounted and includes fully gasketed polycarbonate housing and stainless-steel latches to ensure protection against dust, moisture, and corrosion. Instant-on feature enables immediate full brightness, and it is eco-friendly with no harmful emissions.

LED Magnetic Strip Retrofit (IRIS SSR)

The IRIS SSR retrofit strip features a magnetic backing, making installation quick and easy on any metal surface. Its construction includes LED strips, LED drivers, and connectors that provide a high output with low power consumption. The light is compatible with dimmer switches for customizable brightness and features a magnetic mount for versatile attachment, eliminating the need for complex hardware.

LED Type C Tubes (Orchid B & BSR)

Designed for compatibility with Type C fixtures, the Orchid B & BSR tubes feature shatterproof, frosted glass construction. These tubes provide high-lumen output and flicker-free lighting and with straightforward mounting process into existing troffer fixtures. Their practical design ensures long-lasting, energy-efficient performance while promoting sustainability.

LED Type A, B, A+B Tubes (Gladolia Series)

The Gladolia Series offers three types of LED tubes with versatile mounting options to cater to various lighting setups. Formed with shatterproof, frosted glass, these tubes are built for durability and safety.

-
Type A tubes are designed for direct replacement of traditional fluorescent tubes, with built-in drivers that allow for easy installation in existing ballasts.

-
Type B tubes bypass ballasts for increased energy efficiency, connecting directly to line voltage.

-
Type A+B tubes offer flexibility, working with or without ballasts and providing smooth retrofitting options for any application.

LED Outdoor Garage Lighting Applications in Different Areas

Here’s a look at the different applications of parking lot lighting fixtures and how it improves efficiency and safety in various areas:

-
Parking Decks: LED garage lighting in Parking such as LED Vapor Highbay Fixtures provide wide, uniform coverage and can enhance safety by minimizing shadows and blind spots in parking areas.

-
Entrances and Exits: For improving visibility at critical points, consider using lights with wide-angle illumination, such as LED Garage Canopy Lights

-
Stairwells and Elevators: LED Covered Strip Fixtures deliver bright, even lighting in compact spaces, reducing accident risk. Their covered design ensures long-lasting performance in confined areas.

-
Service Areas: For service areas, LED Vapor-Tight Fixtures are the solution. Theses are sealed against dust and moisture and provide reliable, bright illumination and safety in workspaces.

-
Storage Areas: LED Magnetic Strip Retrofits offer adjustable, energy-efficient lighting that can be easily repositioned for different setups. They ensure optimal visibility and reduced operational costs.

-
Safety and Emergency Zones: Use LED Type A+B Tubes to ensure clear visibility in escape routes and safety equipment during emergencies. Plus, use Chicago approved exit signs as well when putting lights for safety and emergency zones.

-
Security and Surveillance Areas: LED Fixtures with advanced sensors enhance security with motion detection and bright lighting, improving camera visibility and reducing intrusion risks.

Ditch the dim and embrace the glow with Maverick LED! Dial (214) 571-6374 or drop us a message at sales@maverickled.com to boost your garage door lights today! You can also explore our range of outdoor retrofit fixtures on our website.

docs.title: Office Lighting
docs.text:
Maverick LED introduces its collection of office lights designed for high efficiency and elegance. Perfect for any workspace, including open-plan offices, conference rooms, and private workspaces, these LED office lights offer superior brightness while consuming minimal energy. Their advanced LED technology ensures consistent, glare-free, flicker-free illumination, reducing eye strain and enhancing productivity. And customizable controls allow you to change the brightness settings according to different task requirements. Our LED office lighting collection is backed by a 7-year warranty, which adds to its reliability. So, explore all offerings here and order according to your office needs!

LED Office Lighting Fixture Range

Maverick LED have a diverse range of LED lights for office settings. In order to make the selection process easy for you, we have categorized it. In the below section, you will find the suitable information on these classifications:-

LED Troffers

For large commercial spaces where overhead illumination is required, these LED troffers are the ideal solution. They offer even, diffused light and fit in standard ceiling grids. These lighting solutions are ideal for general lighting in office spaces, providing uniform, bright light suitable for different workstations. You can find the following options in our troffers range:

-
Redwood GSR+ LED Volumetric Troffer

-
Lilac GSR LED Volumetric Troffer Retrofit

-
LED Volumetric Troffer (Smart SWS)

Architectural and Strip Lights

The sleek and stylish architectural lights can be used indoors or outdoors, accentuating design features, illuminating workstations, and highlighting corridors. The adaptability and versatility of strip lights make them ideal for a wide variety of applications, including under-cabinet lighting, architectural highlights, and accent lighting. These are architectural and strip lights available in our LED office lighting assortment:

-
Aspen G LED Architectural Linear Strip Light

-
LED Covered Strip Fixture (Juniper GSR)

-
LED Strip Fixture Retrofit, Lily S & G Edition

Downlights

Whether it's a lobby, reception area, or an individual office, downlights are ideal for providing concentrated illumination. They provide target lighting with a sleek and inconspicuous light source, which reduces shadows and creates a warm ambiance. Their compact design and high-quality LED technology deliver exceptional performance and energy savings. You check the details about the light here:

-
Willow G LED Downlight

Magnetic and Tube Retrofits

We offer a range of retrofit options to help you upgrade your existing office lighting system without the hassle of replacing entire fixtures. The IRIS SSR LED Magnetic Strip Retrofit is ideal for replacing fluorescent strips without rewiring. These retrofits are suitable for general office areas, utility rooms, and garages. Check all options in this section:

-
IRIS SSR LED Magnetic Strip Retrofit

-
Orchid B & BSR LED Type C Tubes Retrofit

-
Gladolia Series LED Tubes (Type A, Type B, and Type A+B)

Why LED Lights are Recommended for Office

Energy Efficiency and Cost Savings

One of the primary reasons LED lights are recommended for office workspaces is their exceptional energy efficiency. LEDs (Light-Emitting Diodes) consume significantly less power than traditional incandescent and fluorescent lights. According to the U.S. Department of Energy, LEDs use at least 75% less energy and last 25 times longer than incandescent lighting. This translates to substantial cost savings on electricity bills and reduced maintenance expenses due to their longer lifespan.

Improved Office Lighting Quality and Productivity

The quality of lighting in an office environment directly affects employee productivity and well-being. Unlike fluorescent lights, LEDs do not produce the flicker that can cause headaches and discomfort, thus creating a more comfortable working environment. Besides this, LEDs offer better color rendering, meaning they more accurately represent the true colors of objects. This is particularly important in settings where color differentiation is crucial, such as design or detail-oriented work.

Customizable Office Lighting Solutions

LED technology allows for a high degree of customization, enabling offices to tailor lighting to specific needs and preferences. LEDs can be easily dimmed, and their color temperature can be adjusted from warm to cool light, depending on the time of day or the nature of the work being performed. For example, cooler, blue-enriched light can enhance alertness and cognitive function during the morning hours, while warmer light can create a more relaxed atmosphere towards the end of the day.

Technological Integration and Smart Office Lighting

Our LED lights are compatible with smart office lighting systems, which can be controlled remotely via smartphones, tablets, or computer systems. These systems can automate lighting schedules, adjust brightness levels based on natural light availability, and even respond to our LiteLinQ occupancy sensors to conserve energy when rooms are not in use. This integration supports the creation of intelligent workspaces that adapt to employees' needs and optimize energy usage.

Influential Heat Reduction

LEDs are highly recommended for office settings due to their significant heat reduction. Unlike traditional incandescent and halogen bulbs, LEDs generate minimal heat, reducing the burden on cooling systems and maintaining a comfortable work environment. Besides this, the reduced heat output minimizes the risk of overheating sensitive electronic equipment, ensuring a more stable and efficient workspace.

Environmental Benefits

LEDs have a smaller carbon footprint due to their lower energy consumption and longer operational life, which results in fewer replacements and decreased waste. They are also safer for people and the environment than fluorescent lights since they do not contain mercury. Along with opting for solar products and solutions, businesses can lessen their effect on the environment by switching to LED office lighting.

docs.text:
Investment in outdoor LED lighting is an approach to safety and architectural enhancement. At Maverick LED, we contribute to your approach with our top-tier selection of high-quality lighting solutions. Our range includes versatile lights, offering adjustable wattage and the option for photocell and PIR sensor integration, augmenting the security of any exterior.

Explore our extensive selection and ensure your LED outdoor lighting experience is reliable, energy-efficient, and exceptional in performance.

Our Range of Outdoor Lighting For Your Needs

We offer an extensive range of LED outdoor lights, including:

LED Area Lighting

LED Area Light (Lion SSR)

LED Area Light (Wolf GSR)

LED Area Light (Panther BSR)

LED Parking Garage Light (Kodiak G)

LED Petroleum Canopy Light (Lynx B)

LED Soffit Canopy Retrofit (Jasmine S)

LED Flood Light (Puma G)

Why LED Lights Are Outdoor Illumination Compatible?

Outdoor LED Lamps have, over the years, proven to be a great augmentation to any residential, commercial, or industrial property. Here are why these are the best options for outdoor illumination:

Superior Durability in Various Weather Conditions

The exterior of any property is subjected to extreme conditions, but this shouldn't stop us from illuminating it. Hence, outdoor led light fixtures are designed to function in all weather conditions, including heavy rain, snow, high winds, and intense heat. Moreover, they are often made with materials like aluminum or stainless steel, which resist rust and corrosion. This is particularly important in coastal areas where salt air can rapidly degrade other types of lighting. This makes them ideal for environments that experience frequent or severe weather changes.

Enhanced Energy Efficiency with Low Heat Emission

LEDs are highly energy-efficient, converting most of the electricity they consume into light rather than heat. This efficiency is particularly beneficial in outdoor settings, where lighting may need to remain on for extended periods, such as in parking lots, streets, or outdoor commercial spaces. LEDs can use up to 80% less energy than traditional incandescent or halogen bulbs, leading to significant savings on energy bills.

Longevity and Reduced Maintenance Costs

Outdoor LED lights have an average lifespan of 25,000 to 50,000 hours, significantly longer than incandescent, halogen, or even compact fluorescent bulbs. Moreover, they are less prone to failures caused by vibration or shock, common issues in outdoor settings exposed to environmental factors. This reliability translates into lower maintenance costs over the lifetime of the lights, making them a cost-effective choice.

Optimal Color Rendering and Brightness Control

One reason LED lights are typically preferred for outdoor areas is that they offer a high CRI, often above 80, rendering colors more accurately and vividly than traditional lighting. Also, they offer superior brightness control and can be easily dimmed or adjusted to suit different needs and times of day. With us, you can find high-quality Skyfi Blu controls to adjust your lights to different settings.

Immediate Illumination

Unlike some traditional lighting options, which may take time to warm up and reach full brightness, outdoor LED lights provide instant illumination. This is particularly beneficial in situations where lights need to be turned on suddenly, such as in response to motion detection for security purposes.

Factors Considerations While choosing LED outdoor lighting

Lumen Output and Brightness Levels

Understanding the lumen output and brightness levels is crucial when selecting outdoor LED lighting. Unlike wattage, which measures energy consumption, lumens measure the actual brightness of the light. It’s important to determine the required lumen output based on the specific outdoor area you’re lighting. For instance, pathways may need around 100-200 lumens per light, while parking lots or large open areas might require 2,000 lumens or more per fixture. Additionally, it’s essential to ensure the selected LED lights offer the right brightness without causing excessive glare or light pollution, which can be an issue in residential areas or near-natural habitats.

Color Temperature

Another key factor in selecting outdoor LED lighting is choosing the appropriate color temperature. LED lights are available in a range of color temperatures, typically measured in Kelvins (K). For outdoor settings, a color temperature of 2,700K to 3,000K (warm white) creates a cozy, attractive atmosphere suitable for residential or decorative lighting. In contrast, a cooler temperature of 4,000K to 5,000K (neutral to cool white) is ideal for security or task lighting as it provides brighter, more focused illumination.

Energy Efficiency and Power Consumption

While LEDs are generally energy-efficient, it’s important to consider the overall power consumption, especially if the lights will be on for extended periods. Look for LEDs with high efficacy ratings (lumens per watt) to maximize energy savings, which is particularly crucial in commercial or large residential installations where the cumulative energy costs can be significant.

Weather Resistance and Durability

The IP (Ingress Protection) rating of outdoor LED lights is essential in ensuring durability against environmental factors. The first digit in the IP rating indicates protection against solid objects like dust, while the second digit indicates protection against liquids such as rain. For outdoor use, a minimum IP65 rating is recommended. Additionally, the materials used in the construction of the LED fixture should be corrosion-resistant and durable. Aluminum and stainless steel are common choices.

Installation and Mounting Options

Depending on the location and purpose, consider whether the LED lighting requires a complex installation process involving electrical wiring or if it’s a simpler plug-and-play or solar option. Professional assistance may be required for large-scale installations, while simpler setups might be suitable for DIY projects. Additionally, the ability to mount lights in various positions—such as wall mounted, ground stakes, or pole-mounted—is essential for meeting different lighting needs.

Don’t settle for basic; get your hands on our cutting-edge outdoor LED lighting solutions and indoor retrofits to amp up your exteriors and interiors today!

docs.title: Outdoor Retrofit Kits
docs.text:
At Maverick LED, we offer a cutting-edge collection of retrofit LED kits designed to perfectly combine practicality and efficiency. Suitable for a wide range of applications, from office buildings and retail spaces to warehouses and residential areas, these retrofit kits offer a straightforward installation process. Hence, there is no requirement to revamp the whole lighting structure. These outdoor retrofit kits are made from die-cast aluminum and promise long-term reliability and minimal maintenance. So, browse our collection and order the retrofit kit that meets your lighting needs.

Different Types Of High Bay Retrofit Kits in Our Collection

HID Outdoor Retrofit Kit (Tulip B)

The Tulip B HID Outdoor Retrofit Kit has an external driver for easy access and installation, enhancing performance, energy savings, and longevity. Its durable extruded aluminum body ensures superior heat dissipation, while optional motion and dimming sensors offer customizable control. Coupled with a 7-year warranty, it guarantees reliable and sustainable outdoor illumination.

HID Post Top Retrofit

Our collection's HID Post-Top Retrofit is crafted from extruded aluminum and replaces metal halide lamps in post-top fixtures. Available in 30W - 60W, the retrofit utilizes the Maverick LED driver, which supports 0-10V dimming capabilities. The system is also compatible with motion and dimming sensors, photocells, and wireless control systems, allowing for customizable lighting solutions.

HID Highbay Retrofit

The HID Highbay Retrofit is intended to replace 150W-400W HID fixtures while consuming up to 80% less energy. Featuring 80W-100W wattage, 113-128 LM/W efficacy, and 9,751-10,929 lumens, this retrofit ensures optimal brightness. Ideal for warehouses, gyms, and shopping centers, it comes with an EX39 Mogul Base for easy installation and an IP44 rating for durability.

360° HID Retrofit (Corn Cob)

Featuring a compact, corn-cob design, the 360° HID Retrofit (Corn Cob) provides uniform, omnidirectional light distribution with a wide 360° beam angle, ensuring comprehensive coverage. Its high-lumen output and superior heat dissipation deliver bright, consistent illumination while considerably reducing energy consumption and maintenance.

180° Single Side Paddle HID Retrofit

Designed for durability, our 180° Single Side Paddle HID Retrofit features a die-cast aluminum housing and a polycarbonate lens, ensuring long-lasting performance. With wattage options from 36W to 115W, it delivers high efficacy (111-119 LM/W) and a bright output of 4,008-12,819 lumens at 5000K. Ideal for parking lots, street lights, wall packs, and floodlights, this IP64-rated retrofit is built to withstand the elements and comes with a 5-year warranty.

Applications of Outdoor Retrofit Kits

Street and Roadway Lighting

LED Retrofit Kits are integral to modernizing street and roadway lighting. They provide superior brightness and uniform illumination, which is crucial for driver and pedestrian safety. With a high Color Rendering Index (CRI), LED retrofits improve visibility and color perception, reducing accidents and enhancing security.

Parking Lot Lighting

In parking lots, LED Retrofit Kits ensure well-lit environments that deter crime and enhance safety. LEDs' broad light distribution minimizes dark spots and shadows, while their instant-on capability eliminates the warm-up time associated with older lighting technologies.

Park and Recreational Area Lighting

These parks and recreational spaces retrofit kits offer continuous, natural lighting that improves the user experience while assuring nighttime safety. LEDs' flexibility in dimming controls and motion sensors makes them perfect for these applications, allowing for customized lighting solutions that save energy during off-peak hours.

Security Lighting

LED Retrofit Kits provide intense, concentrated illumination that is appropriate for security lighting applications. Their capacity to emit bright, white light assists in correctly identifying objects and persons, hence improving security in residential, commercial, and industrial situations.

Billboard and Signage Lighting

They are highly effective in billboard and signage lighting. These retrofit kits offer vibrant, uniform light that makes advertisements more visible and attractive. LEDs' long lifespan reduces the need for frequent maintenance, which is particularly beneficial in hard-to-reach signage locations.

Benefits of Outdoor LED Retrofit Kits

Energy Savings for Outdoor Lighting

The LED retrofits are highly energy-efficient, consuming up to 80% less energy than traditional lighting sources like high-pressure sodium or metal halide lamps. This efficiency is due to the LEDs' ability to convert more electricity into visible light rather than wasted heat.

Minimal Maintenance for Hard-to-Reach Fixtures

LEDs have a far longer lifetime than conventional lighting sources, often reaching 50,000 hours of use. This prolonged life decreases the need for maintenance, which is especially useful for hard-to-reach exterior fixtures. The decreased need for bulb replacements and maintenance results in cheaper labor costs and less interruption in situations requiring continuous illumination, such as highways or big commercial sites.

Reduced Light Pollution

LED retrofit kits can be engineered with precise optics and directional lighting, minimizing unwanted light spills and glare. This targeted illumination helps reduce light pollution, preserving the night sky and reducing the impact on surrounding environments. Such control over light distribution is crucial for compliance with dark-sky initiatives and for creating more eco-friendly urban environments.

Upgraded Aesthetic and Brand Image

Proper lighting in commercial places, such as malls, office buildings, and retail establishments, is essential for establishing a good impression on customers and attracting new ones. LED retrofit kits can be used to design aesthetically pleasing lighting settings.

Outdoor and Harsh Environment Durability

LED retrofits are highly durable and can withstand harsh conditions, making them ideal for outdoor and industrial applications. LEDs resist vibrations, extreme temperatures, and moisture, ensuring reliable performance in challenging environments such as parking lots, loading docks, and outdoor signage.

Compliance with Environmental and Safety Regulations

Numerous commercial and industrial spaces must adhere to stringent environmental and safety requirements concerning energy use and handling dangerous substances. LED retrofits enable companies to comply with these requirements by being devoid of hazardous compounds such as mercury, which is present in fluorescent and HID bulbs.

Along with Outdoor LED Retrofit Kits, Maverick LED offers a diverse range of electrical solutions, including Pole Mounts, Emergency Drivers, Indoor Stand alone Controls, Short Tenons, and more. If you need further information about our offerings, contact us at 214-571-6374 or write to us at sales@maverickled.com to have your queries addressed instantly.

docs.title: Pole Mounts
docs.text:
At Maverick LED, we have pole mounts in-store that offer a reliable and versatile solution for installing outdoor LED lighting in various settings. With us, you can find options that are made using highly durable carbon steel and are coated with a protective powder finish to offer resistance to environmental conditions. Our collection includes pole wall mounts in different sizes and types, making them perfect for both residential and commercial applications. They are compatible with various LED fixtures, allowing for customized lighting setups that maximize light distribution, reduce energy consumption, and enhance safety and visibility.

Explore our collection today to find the perfect pole mount for your lighting needs!

Our Varieties in Pole Mounts

Mount Brackets

Our pole mount brackets are specifically engineered to secure lighting fixtures in different configurations, providing flexibility in installation and placement. The available options include:

-
L-Shape Wall Mount Bracket: Allows for mounting lights on walls or other flat surfaces.

-
Straight Wall Mount Bracket: Perfect for direct wall mounting, this bracket keeps the lighting fixture parallel to the wall.

Tenon

Tenon mounts are crucial for adjusting light poles to different lighting angles and configurations. These specialized adapters connect light fixtures to poles, especially those designed to support multiple fixtures. Our range of tenon mounts include:

-
Side Tenon Mount For Square Pole: Attach directly to square poles, allows lights to be installed at the side of the pole.

-
4” Square Tenon Adapter: Converts square poles into a tenon-compatible mount.

-
4" Square 180º Bracket: Allows for the installation of two lighting fixtures on opposite sides of the pole.

-
4” Short 180º Twin Tenon: With two tenons aligned at 180º, this mount supports two fixtures, allowing for back-to-back lighting setups.

-
4” Short 90º Twin Tenon: Holds two fixtures at a 90º angle from each other.

-
4” Short 90º Triple Tenon: Places three fixtures at 90º intervals.

-
4” Short Square 90º Quad Tenon: These short tenon hold four fixtures, each at a 90º angle, allowing for comprehensive 360º lighting from a single pole.

-
4” Square Low Profile 180º Dual Tenon: Low-profile version of the twin tenon mount, supports two fixtures on opposite sides of the pole.

-
4” Square Low Profile 180º Triple Tenon: Ideal for installations that require three fixtures, this low-profile mount distributes light at 180º.

-
4” Square Low Profile 180º Quad Tenon: Allows mounting of four fixtures in a low-profile, symmetrical setup.

Benefits of pole wall mounts

Space-saving Design

Pole wall mounts allow lighting fixtures to be installed directly on walls or other vertical structures, saving valuable ground space. This is especially useful in areas where ground-level obstructions need to be minimized, such as walkways, narrow streets, or parking garages.

Improved Light Efficiency and Uniformity

These mounts enable lighting fixtures to be strategically positioned at heights that allow for better light uniformity and coverage. By lifting the fixtures, they spread light more evenly over large areas, reducing dark spots and improving overall visibility and contributing to the security of the area.

Cost-effective Installation

They reduce the need for additional poles or infrastructure, cutting down installation costs. Instead of erecting standalone poles, lights can be directly mounted onto existing walls, making the process more efficient and affordable, especially in urban areas.

Durability and Longevity

These mounts are typically made from corrosion-resistant materials like galvanized steel or aluminum, ensuring they withstand harsh weather conditions such as rain, snow, and high winds. This extends the lifespan of the lighting system and reduces maintenance costs over time.

Customizable Lighting Solutions

Pole wall mounts allow for flexible installation angles and heights, ensuring that lighting can be directed exactly where it's needed. This is critical in areas that require focused illumination, such as building entrances, parking lots, or narrow alleyways.

Compliance with Safety Standards

They help lighting systems meet necessary safety codes, especially in public and commercial areas where adequate lighting is required to prevent accidents and comply with local regulations.

Ready to enhance your outdoor lighting with reliable and versatile solutions? Explore our wide range of durable pole wall mounts, LED lightning solutions and retrofit kits today, and find the perfect fit for your residential, commercial, or industrial lighting needs.

docs.title: Warehouse Lighting & Commercial Lighting
docs.text:
LED Warehouse Lighting

Upgrade your warehouse with MaverickLED’s high-performance LED warehouse lighting solutions. We are dedicated to providing top-quality lights for optimal performance, efficiency, and cost savings. Our range of products includes everything from High Bay Lighting for spacious, high-ceiling environments to Strip Lights that offer sleek, efficient lighting for narrow aisles. We also have vapor-tight lighting to withstand excessive moisture and dust. Our mission is to provide sustainable, energy-efficient commercial lighting to maximize visibility, safety, and longevity. Let’s give you a quick sneak peek at our LED warehouse lighting fixtures range.

LED Warehouse Lighting Fixtures Range

High Bay Lighting:

High bays work best in areas with high ceilings, typically 20 to 35 feet in height. There are two types of high-bay lighting:

Round High Bay Lights: These provide a wide beam that covers large areas, making them great for open spaces. They are easy to install with just one contact point.

Linear High Bay Lights: The lights have a more focused, rectangular spread, perfect for illuminating specific aisles and shelves. They can be mounted on the surface, suspended, or pendant-mounted.

Here are the high bay lights in our collection:

LED LINEAR HIGHBAY (PINE SSR)

LED FULL BODY HIGHBAY (MAPLE B)

LED ROUND HIGHBAY (ASH GSR+)

LED ROUND HIGHBAY (OAK SSR)

LED Round Highbay (Ash SSR)

Strip Lighting:

Strip lights have a low-profile design and work great in buildings with size-restricted architectural designs. They provide bright, even lighting and are typically ceiling-mounted, but they can also be suspended from the ceiling.

Our Options:

LED COVERED STRIP FIXTURE (JUNIPER GSR)

LED STRIP FIXTURE RETROFIT (LILY S & G)

Vapor Tight Lighting:

These fixtures led lighting are designed to operate in less-than-ideal conditions and are perfect for applications that require dust, dirt, and moisture resistance.

Our product range for Vapor Tight Lighting:

LED VAPOR TIGHT FIXTURE (HAZEL GSR)

LED VAPOR HIGHBAY FIXTURE (HAZEL GSR)

Troffer Lighting:

Troffer lights, also known as drop-ceiling fixtures, are a common choice in large warehouses that need bright recessed lighting. They have a low-profile design and reduce glare using a reflector or diffuser. Troffer lights can provide both direct and indirect lighting.

What we have in our collection:

LED VOLUMETRIC TROFFER (REDWOOD GSR+)

LED Volumetric Troffer Retrofit (Lilac GSR)

LED VOLUMETRIC TROFFER (SMART SWS)

High Bay Retrofit:

High Bay Retrofit lights are an excellent solution for upgrading existing LED fixtures. They offer efficient lighting and easy installation.

HID HIGHBAY RETROFIT

Sensors and Controls:

For enhanced warehouse lighting and commercial lighting management and energy savings, these sensors and controls are highly effective:

PIR On/Off Occupancy Sensor (06247)

PIR 3-in-1 Occupancy Sensor (06246)

DC Powered PIR 3-in-1 Motion Sensor (06251)

DC Powered OcuSense 3-in-1 Motion Sensor (06267)

DC Powered PIR 3-in-1 Motion Sensor (06254)

LED Warehouse Lighting Applications In Different Areas

Utility & Storage Rooms

Utility and storage rooms usually require less intense lighting. For these spaces, low-maintenance and energy-efficient options like linear fixtures are ideal. These lights provide adequate illumination without excessive brightness, making them cost-effective and practical for areas where detailed tasks are not the primary focus.

Warehouse Loading Dock Lighting

Loading docks, being high-traffic zones, demand substantial illumination to ensure safety and efficiency. High bay fixtures are commonly used indoors due to their high lumen output, providing bright and uniform lighting. Vapor-tight lights are recommended for outdoor areas as they offer weatherproof illumination, essential for maintaining visibility in various weather conditions.

Workshops

Due to the complexity of tasks performed, workshops require high-quality commercial lighting. Low-bay lights are preferred for their exceptional lumen output over a wide area, ensuring clear visibility for detailed work. To cover any gaps left by the low-bay lighting, linear shop lights are often added, enhancing overall illumination and reducing shadows to improve accuracy and efficiency in the workspace.

Cold Storage

In cold storage areas, where refrigeration causes condensation, fixture LED lighting must be sealed from moisture. Vapor-tight fixtures are the best choice for these environments as they are moisture-resistant and provide consistent lumen output over a broad area.

Bulk Storage

In bulk storage areas, where tasks involve reading labels and locating large items, LED High Bay Lighting fixtures, with appropriate lumen output and spacing adjustments, effectively provide the required light levels.

Rack Aisles

Rack aisles, which store oversized items and are navigated by forklifts or pallet jacks, need specific lighting for safety and functionality. Therefore, downlight LED fixtures can be used to safely locate items and maneuver material handling equipment.

Pick/Pack or Shipping Area

Higher light levels are necessary for accurate tasks in pick/pack or shipping areas, where small items are picked and orders are packed. Strip Lighting LED fixtures are suitable for providing bright, even light so that workers can efficiently and accurately handle items in staging areas or during the packing process.

Bay Doors

Bay doors, which lead to trailers or containers, require specific lighting solutions for the interior of shipping containers or trailers. LED Troffer Lighting can be used to provide adequate illumination in these areas. So, that workers can see clearly while moving materials into or out of containers, enhancing safety and efficiency during shipping.

Exterior Walls

Outside LED lights, such as wall pack lights, can effectively illuminate the warehouse's exterior walls. These LED fixtures are designed to withstand outdoor elements and require minimal maintenance throughout their long lifespan.

Office and Administration

Office and administration areas within a warehouse, where tasks include computer work and filing, need appropriate lighting for comfort and productivity. LED Troffer warehouse Lighting fixtures, offering bright and evenly distributed light, are ideal for these spaces.

Improvise your warehouse operations with MaverickLED’s advanced lighting solutions. Reach out to us for long-lasting, low-maintenance lights.

Privacy policy

Last updated: July 14, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Maverick LED (the "Site", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and discloses your personal information when you visit, use our services, or make a purchase from maverickled.com (the "Site") or otherwise communicate with us regarding the Site (collectively, the "Services"). For purposes of this Privacy Policy, "you" and "your" means you as the user of the Services, whether you are a customer, website visitor, or another individual whose information we have collected pursuant to this Privacy Policy.

Please read this Privacy Policy carefully.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, including to reflect changes to our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will post the revised Privacy Policy on the Site, update the "Last updated" date and take any other steps required by applicable law.

How We Collect and Use Your Personal Information

To provide the Services, we collect and have collected over the past 12 months personal information about you from a variety of sources, as set out below. The information that we collect and use varies depending on how you interact with us.

In addition to the specific uses set out below, we may use information we collect about you to communicate with you, provide or improve or improve the Services, comply with any applicable legal obligations, enforce any applicable terms of service, and to protect or defend the Services, our rights, and the rights of our users or others.

What Personal Information We Collect

The types of personal information we obtain about you depends on how you interact with our Site and use our Services. When we use the term "personal information", we are referring to information that identifies, relates to, describes or can be associated with you. The following sections describe the categories and specific types of personal information we collect.

Information We Collect Directly from You

Information that you directly submit to us through our Services may include:

-
Contact details including your name, address, phone number, and email.

-
Order information including your name, billing address, shipping address, payment confirmation, email address, and phone number.

-
Account information including your username, password, security questions and other information used for account security purposes.

-
Customer support information including the information you choose to include in communications with us, for example, when sending a message through the Services.

Some features of the Services may require you to directly provide us with certain information about yourself. You may elect not to provide this information, but doing so may prevent you from using or accessing these features.

Information We Collect about Your Usage

We may also automatically collect certain information about your interaction with the Services ("Usage Data"). To do this, we may use cookies, pixels and similar technologies ("Cookies"). Usage Data may include information about how you access and use our Site and your account, including device information, browser information, information about your network connection, your IP address and other information regarding your interaction with the Services.

Information We Obtain from Third Parties

Finally, we may obtain information about you from third parties, including from vendors and service providers who may collect information on our behalf, such as:

- Companies who support our Site and Services, such as Shopify.

- Our payment processors, who collect payment information (e.g., bank account, credit or debit card information, billing address) to process your payment in order to fulfill your orders and provide you with products or services you have requested, in order to perform our contract with you.

- When you visit our Site, open or click on emails we send you, or interact with our Services or advertisements, we, or third parties we work with, may automatically collect certain information using online tracking technologies such as pixels, web beacons, software developer kits, third-party libraries, and cookies.

Any information we obtain from third parties will be treated in accordance with this Privacy Policy. Also see the section below, Third Party Websites and Links.

How We Use Your Personal Information

-
Providing Products and Services. We use your personal information to provide you with the Services in order to perform our contract with you, including to process your payments, fulfill your orders, to send notifications to you related to your account, purchases, returns, exchanges or other transactions, to create, maintain and otherwise manage your account, to arrange for shipping, facilitate any returns and exchanges and other features and functionalities related to your account.

-
Marketing and Advertising. We may use your personal information for marketing and promotional purposes, such as to send marketing, advertising and promotional communications by email, text message or postal mail, and to show you advertisements for products or services. This may include using your personal information to better tailor the Services and advertising on our Site and other websites. If you are an EEA resident, the legal basis for these data processing activities is our legitimate interest in selling our products, according to Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

-
Security and Fraud Prevention. We use your personal information to detect, investigate or take action regarding possible fraudulent, illegal or malicious activity. If you choose to use the Services and register an account, you are responsible for keeping your account credentials safe. We highly recommend that you do not share your username, password, or other access details with anyone else. If you believe your account has been compromised, please contact us immediately. If you are an EEA resident, the legal basis for these data processing activities is our legitimate interest in keeping our website secure for you and other customers, according to Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

-
Communicating with You and Service Improvement. We use your personal information to provide you with customer support and improve our Services. This is in our legitimate interests in order to be responsive to you, to provide effective services to you, and to maintain our business relationship with you according to Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

Cookies

Like many websites, we use Cookies on our Site. For specific information about the Cookies that we use related to powering our store with Shopify, see https://www.shopify.com/legal/cookies. We use Cookies to power and improve our Site and our Services (including to remember your actions and preferences), to run analytics and better understand user interaction with the Services (in our legitimate interests to administer, improve and optimize the Services). We may also permit third parties and services providers to use Cookies on our Site to better tailor the services, products and advertising on our Site and other websites.

Most browsers automatically accept Cookies by default, but you can choose to set your browser to remove or reject Cookies through your browser controls. Please keep in mind that removing or blocking Cookies can negatively impact your user experience and may cause some of the Services, including certain features and general functionality, to work incorrectly or no longer be available. Additionally, blocking Cookies may not completely prevent how we share information with third parties such as our advertising partners.

Our website also recognizes the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal, which enables you to opt-out of certain uses or disclosures of your information. If you notify us of your preference through GPC, we will treat such signal as a valid request to opt out of sharing / targeted advertising for the associated browser or device, and, if we are able to associate the device sending the signal to a Shopify account, we will apply the opt out request to the account as well. To learn more about Global Privacy Control, you can visit https://globalprivacycontrol.org/. Other than the Global Privacy Control, we do not recognize other “Do Not Track” signals that may be sent from your web browser or device.

In certain circumstances, we may disclose your personal information to third parties for contract fulfillment purposes, legitimate purposes and other reasons subject to this Privacy Policy. Such circumstances may include:

docs.title: Utilizing Daylight Harvesting in LED Lighting Applications
docs.text:
Utilizing Daylight Harvesting in LED Lighting Applications

In an era where sustainable practices and energy efficiency are paramount, daylight-harvesting LED lights have emerged as a revolutionary solution. These innovative lighting systems utilize natural daylight, seamlessly integrating it with artificial lighting to create a well-balanced and energy-efficient environment. Utilizing network lighting controls with LED lights brings numerous benefits to both residential and commercial spaces, offering enhanced comfort, reduced energy consumption, and improved productivity. Let's delve deeper into the advantages and applications of this remarkable lighting technology.

Energy Efficiency:
Sensor ready LED lights offer significant benefits in terms of energy efficiency. These lights have the capability to maximize energy consumption by utilizing natural light. They are equipped with sensors and control systems that detect the amount of natural light present and adjust their brightness levels accordingly.

Enhanced Comfort and Well-being:
Daylight-harvesting LED lights create a visually pleasing and comfortable environment by replicating the natural patterns of daylight. The dynamic lighting levels throughout the day helps regulate our circadian rhythm, promoting better sleep patterns, improved mood, and increased productivity.

Environmental Sustainability:
By utilizing natural daylight as the primary source of illumination, these lights reduce the need for artificial lighting, resulting in lower energy consumption.

Application Versatility:
LED Fixtures capable of daylight harvesting are suitable for a variety of applications including, offices, schools, healthcare facilities, retail and residential. By intelligently combining natural and artificial lighting, daylight harvesting LED lights provide consistent illumination levels throughout the day, regardless of external weather conditions.

docs.title: Utilizing Daylight Harvesting in LED Lighting Applications
docs.text:
Utilizing Daylight Harvesting In LED Lighting Applications

June 8, 2023

by Diksha Saxena

Have you ever thought about how natural light can make indoor lighting smarter and more efficient? Daylight harvesting does just that by using smart controls with indoor LED lighting according to the amount of natural light present. This will reduce energy consumption while ensuring that there is adequate illumination in the room. Daylight is not only an illumination source, but it helps improve our mood and ensures our circadian rhythm remains stable and keeps electricity bills low.

With more people learning about the advantages of daylight and the need for energy saving, property owners have figured out how to incorporate sunlight into their buildings again. The combination of LED lighting for warehouses and daylight harvesting makes for a productive and sustainable lighting system in buildings. Let’s see how exactly daylight harvesting works:

What Is Daylight Harvesting?

Daylight harvesting is a smart lighting technique that uses natural light to illuminate the indoor spaces of modern buildings. This system uses sensors and controls to adjust LED lighting based on the natural light coming into a certain room. It is best for places where there's plenty of sunlight coming in through windows or doors. The purpose is to adjust lighting levels throughout the day by reducing the need for electric lights when natural light is sufficient.

How Does Daylight Harvesting Work?

There are two types of daylight harvesting: Open-loop and Closed-loop. Both types have different functions and applications from one another. Let's see what the difference is between these solar solutions and how they work!

Open-loop daylight harvesting: An open-loop control system will use a photosensor to sense the amount of natural light to set the level of artificial lighting. The photosensor is normally mounted outside or near windows to sense daylight levels. There will be no feedback from electric lighting in an open-loop control system; however, the control will be done by adjusting the natural light.

Daylight Harvesting Using Closed-loop Control System: In this system, a photosensor will sense the light level of a room, taking into consideration both the sunlight and the electric lights. With this information, the light level of electric lights will be adjusted so that the predetermined ambient light level can be achieved. These sensors are normally indoors, away from windows, and sense the light level of electric lights.

How Smart LED Lighting Revolutionizes Daylight Harvesting

Integration with IoT and Building Automation

It will be effortless for you to manage the lighting system of your building if your LED lights have the capability to connect to IoT (Internet of Things) and the building automation system. The LED lights for parking facilities can be linked with other smart devices, including motion sensors, thermostats, and surveillance cameras, through wireless connectivity technologies such as Bluetooth, Zigbee, and Wi-Fi.

For instance, once the motion sensor detects that there is nobody in the room, the LED lights will automatically go off to reduce power consumption of power. They can even function with HVAC systems to ensure that there is no wastage of power in unoccupied rooms.

With such an arrangement, you can be able to manage all these LED lights from a single place through the dashboard, where you will see data regarding energy consumption of energy and system status.

Adaptive Illumination Zones

Smart LED lighting systems have adaptive illumination zones. These lighting zones change the lighting of the room depending on what task needs to be done and the user's preference. If there is enough natural lighting in the work zone, then the LED lights for schools will dim or switch off automatically. On the other hand, if the spaces do not have natural lighting, then the proper lighting is provided with the help of LED lights. No matter whether the session is formal or casual, the light can always be adjusted based on the mood.

Energy Harvesting Technologies

The energy-generating LEDs are intelligent lights capable of illuminating and generating electricity through solar energy. With the integration of daylight harvesting technologies and LED lights, they make use of solar energy during the day to operate, thus reducing the consumption of electricity from the grid. You can reduce energy expenses and create a sustainable environment by reducing the dependence on fossil fuels and greenhouse gases.

In commercial and residential buildings, energy-generating LEDs can be useful in lowering lighting expenses, particularly in those regions that have too much natural light, including lobbies, conference rooms, and sunrooms. In addition, these lights can also be useful in schools and health care institutions for creating energy-saving spaces with good lighting quality. Such buildings will be able to receive green building certificates such as LEED.

Additional Point

Virtual Sky Ceilings

The lights utilize high-resolution LED panels to simulate daylight and the view of outdoor skies. Together, virtual sky ceilings and daylight harvesting lighting systems help in improving the lighting in areas where there is less natural light available. With such lights, one can experience nature while staying indoors, meaning that the design of such lights is very much similar to that of a natural sky. This system works in a way that it varies depending on the time and weather changes, as in nature, and virtual sky ceilings ensure consistent light quality.

Why Should You Implement Daylight Harvesting?

Environmental Impact

Reducing the use of electric lights for warehouses can easily minimize the carbon footprint and environmental impact, such as air pollution, which relates to electricity generation. It helps provide a cleaner and healthier environment.

Improved Visual Comfort

Natural light creates a more comfortable and pleasant indoor environment. It reduces eye strain and helps to improve the overall health of building residents.

Long-Term Maintenance Savings

If you have installed daylight harvesting, you are free from frequent replacements. Also, less maintenance is required for lighting fixtures owing to the natural lighting, as LED lights for offices switch off automatically. This leads to long-term cost savings and lowers disruption to building operations.

Health Benefits

Natural light supports improving people's mood, reducing stress, and improving productivity. Exposure to natural light confirms the body's natural circadian rhythms, which can contribute to better sleep patterns and overall health among occupants.

Long-Term Investment

Installing daylight harvesting systems can increase the overall value of a property by improving its sustainability credentials and attractiveness to tenants or buyers looking for energy-efficient and environmentally friendly buildings. This investment in sustainable features can help with long-term financial returns and increase the marketability of the property.

Wrapping Up

If you also want to take advantage of these benefits, you can also install daylight harvesting on your property. You can trust Maverick LED to purchase outdoor luminaries and other solar solutions. You will get high-quality materials from them. Save electricity and your money with just one solution.

UNDERSTANDING LUMENS VS. WATTAGE

July 10, 2023

by Diksha Saxena

As far as the topic of lighting is concerned, one is likely to hear about such notions as lumens and watts. Although all these measures play an important role when talking about the sphere of lighting, they mean different things. Therefore, it is vital to understand the difference between total lumens and wattage, as well as how to convert between them.

Lumens: Measure Brightness

Lumens are the total amount of visible light given off by a light source. It is the unit of brightness and directly proportional to the amount of light being radiated. Simply put, the more lumens, the brighter the light will be. Lumens measure brightness for comparison between different light sources, such as LED bulbs (800 lumens), incandescent bulbs (800 lumens), and compact fluorescent lamps (800 lumens), regardless of the technology or type of bulb. Apart from that, lumens help to calculate the amount of energy consumed as the desired lumens will tell you what light source and wattages you should use.

Watts: Measure Power Consumption

The comparison between lumens and watts shows that the watt determines how much power a certain light source requires. The watt is determined through voltage and current, and it ensures that the bulb and other sources of lights are compatible with the electricity supply system. Using appropriate bulbs that fit the required wattages ensures that there will be no fire hazards or damages. The watt is also important in determining the efficiency level of light and the amount of heat produced. Previously, the watt was considered a measure of the brightness of the light of the bulbs, and increased wattages meant greater brightness. But currently, with advanced technology and efficient lighting such as LEDs, this has changed.

Choosing The Right Bulb: Lumens and Wattage Considerations

From lumens to watts, let's look at the following factors to choose the right bulb:

Light Output and Location

The amount of light produced by the bulb is an important parameter that determines the correct choice of a bulb. This is indicated in lumens and shows how much visible light is produced by the bulb. More lumens indicate more brightness, and thus it is important to correlate the number of lumens with the application and where the bulb will be used. For instance, the bulb with 1500-3000 lumens should be used in the living room, while 450-800 lumens should be used in the study room.

Efficacy

Efficacy is measured in lumens per watt (lm/W), which is best used to determine how a bulb converts electric power into visible light. The higher efficacy indicates that you can get more brightness for less energy consumption, automatically leading to low electricity bills and less environmental impact.

Purpose-Based Lighting

The bulbs could be chosen by what they are meant to be used for since there are various purposes for lighting, like general lighting, which can include reading or cooking, which requires task lighting; in which case, the bulbs would have high lumens (cool temperature). If one wanted to emphasize architectural elements using accent lighting, then moderate lumens (warm color temperature) bulbs would be appropriate.

Light Distribution

While selecting a bulb, you must consider its light distribution pattern and understand how lumens translate to watts. LED bulbs offering directional light are ideal for task lighting and spotlights, while incandescent bulbs providing omnidirectional light work well for general room lighting.

Efficiency and the Rise of LEDs

It is a common fact that incandescent bulbs are inefficient because not all energy consumed is converted into light but is lost as heat. In contrast, LEDs are very efficient because most of the energy consumed by them is converted into light, not into heat. As a result of such efficiency, there is a dissociation between the intensity of light emitted and consumed watts. It means that LED emits the same amount of lumens as an incandescent bulb but uses less watts.

Transition to Lumens: The Importance of Choosing the Right Bulb

As the lighting industry moves away from incandescent bulbs towards more energy-efficient options, wattage is less relevant as a measure of brightness. Instead, lumens have become the standard metric for evaluating light output. When selecting bulbs, focus on lumens rather than wattage to ensure you choose the desired level of brightness for your space.

Comparing Lumens and Watts: A Practical Example

For demonstration purposes regarding lumens vs watts, we will provide a sample case that shows how both terms differ. Imagine that there is a 60-watt incandescent bulb at home, but you wish to change it with a newer LED bulb. You should not look for an LED with the similar wattage but rather find an LED bulb that provides the same amount of lumens as the 60-watt incandescent bulb. In most cases, the appropriate replacement will be an LED bulb that emits 800 lumens.

It is important to understand the difference between the total amount of lumens and wattages, that is, the distinction between lumens vs watts. While the lumens are the measure of brightness provided by a certain light source, the wattages are the measure of power consumption. The development of new types of lights, which are more energy-efficient (like LEDs), makes it even more difficult to relate lumens to wattages. But using lumens when buying different lighting products will help in ensuring the desired level of lightness as well as energy efficiency.
